name: City Council Special Meeting
agenda_text:
NOTICE AND CALL OF A SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Azusa is hereby called to be held Wednesday, May 22, 2013 at 06:30 p.m. at 213 E. Foothill Blvd..
Said Special Meeting shall be for discussing, hearing and taking action on the items listed below:
AGENDA
1.
Call to Order
2.
Pledge to the Flag
3.
Invocation - Pastor Matt Marzluft of Village Covenant Church.
A.
PUBLIC PARTICIPATION
Limited to items listed on this Special Meeting Notice.
B.
REPORTS, UPDATES, AND ANNOUNCEMENTS FROM STAFF/COUNCIL
1.
Presentation by Vulcan Materials of $75,000 for the scholarship program required by the Vulcan Development Agreement.
2.
Mayor Rocha: Request for $100.00 sponsorship for Veronica Verdugo, Gladstone High School Student, to attend Cheer Camp
3.
Mayor Rocha: Request for proclamations for retiring Azusa Unified School District Personnel as follows: Teachers: Paramount School: Rosie Medrano, Esther Reyes and Norma Varellas;
Sierra High School: Karen Kardashian;
Gladstone Street School: Carolee Montoya;
Gladstone High School: Scott Carr, Tim Conklin, Jeff Divine, Robert Fuentes;
Foothill Middle School: Madalyn Carberry, Sandra Castle, Alfred Martinez
Instructional Aide: Paramount School: Maria Olivares;
Health Aide: Foothill Middle School: Linda Meave
Attendance Clerk: Foothill Middle School: Nina Wilson
4.
Mayor Rocha: Request for certificate for 21 year old surprise birthday party to be held June 7.
5.
Councilman Carrillo: Discussion of San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments (COG)/Alameda Corridor East (ACE) separation and formation of ACE JPA
6.
Designation of voting delegates and alternate to attend the League of California Cities Annual Conference, September 18-20, in Sacramento.
7.
Discussion regarding selection of temporary Mayor Pro-tem.
B-7 Selection temporary Mayor Pro-tem_1
B-7 Attachments
C.
SCHEDULED ITEMS
1.
APPEAL OF EMPLOYEE RELATIONS OFFICER DECISION ON A PETITION FOR UNIT MODIFICATION.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Hear and consider the arguments of the employee and the City regarding the employee's appeal of the denial of a Petition for Unit Modification and Recognition, and uphold the Employee Relations Officer's Decision to deny the appeal.
C-1 Appeal for Unit Modification and Recognition
C-1 Attachment 1 EERO Reso 10-C93
C-1 Attachment 2 March Petition
C-1 Attachment 3 City Response
C-1 Attachment 4 Approved Consent Item 6-2-2008
C-1 Attachment 5 Appeal of Denial, Unit Modification and Recognition
2.
APPROVAL OF AGREEMENT BETWEEN AZUSA PACIFIC UNIVERSITY (APU) AND THE AZUSA POLICE DEPARTMENT FOR UNIVERSITY RESOURCE OFFICER (URO) SERVICES.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve the Police Department to enter into a one year agreement with APU to provide a full time police officer to serve as a URO for the 2013-2014 APU undergraduate academic school year.
C-2 APU University Resource Officer _URO_
C-2 Attachment 1 APU CRO Proposal
C-2 Attachment 2 PD_APU URO Agreement
D.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The Consent Calendar adopting the printed recommended actions will be enacted with one vote. If Councilmembers or Staff wish to address any item on the Consent Calendar
individually, it will be considered under SPECIAL CALL ITEMS.
1.
APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF MAY 6, 2013, AND THE SPECIAL JOINT MEETING COUNCIL/PLANNING COMMISSION OF APRIL 29, 2013.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Minutes as written.
D-1 Minutes May 6 & April 29, 2013
2.
RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING PAYMENT OF WARRANTS BY THE CITY.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt Resolution No. 13-C30 allowing certain claims and demands and specifying the fund out of which the same are to be paid.
D-2 Reso City Warrant Register
3.
APPROVAL OF THE BOARD OF RESOLUTION, AS REQUIRED BY THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY AREA AGENCY ON AGING, FOR THE AZUSA SENIOR NUTRITION PROGRAM.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt Resolution No. 13-C31, that is required by the Los Angeles County Area Agency on Aging, designating Mayor Joseph Rocha or his designee, City Manager, James Makshanoff, as the authorized representatives to sign the contract and all documents necessary to accompany the contract, including all amendments to said contract within fiscal years 2012-2016.
D-3 L.A. Co. Senior Nutrition Program Resolution
4.
REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP) FOR A PLANNING AND ENVIRONMENTAL CONSULTANT FOR A PROPOSED SPECIFIC PLAN AND EIR FOR THE DHAMMAKAYA INTERNATIONAL MEDITATION CENTER (DIMC) PROJECT
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Authorize staff to circulate a Request for Proposals (RFP) to provide consultant services for preparation of a Specific Plan and Environmental Impact Report documentation for the proposed Dhammakaya International.
D-4 Dhammakaya RFP
D-4 Dhammakaya Exhibit A, Plng Application
D-4 Dhammakaya Exhibit B Specifications
5.
CIP PROJECT #66113A; PAVEMENT MANAGEMENT PROGRAM, AWARD OF CONTRACT TO ALL AMERICAN ASPHALT.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Award the Pavement Management Project to All American Asphalt and authorizes staff to execute a budget amendment in the amount of $430,000 from Prop 1B.
D-5 Award Pavement Mgmt
D-5 Attachment Pavement Management Slurry Locations
6.
CIP #66112F; TRAFFIC SIGNAL CONTROLLER UPGRADES, APPROVE A BUDGET AMENDMENT IN THE AMOUNT OF $16,098.05.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve a budget amendment in the amount of $16,098.05 for CIP 66112F, Traffic Signal Controller Upgrades.
D-6 Traffic Signal Imp Budget Amendmen
7.
CITY TREASURER'S STATEMENT OF CASH AND INVESTMENT BALANCES FOR THE MONTH OF MARCH 2013.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive, review, and file the City Treasurer's Report for the City of Azusa for the month of March 2013.
D-7 Treasurers Report March 2013
D-7 Page 1 Treasr Rprt Bank Accounts
D-7 Page 2 Treas Rpr City CD
D-7 Page 3 Treasr Rpt City Agencies
D-7 Page 4 Treas Rprt LW CD
D-7 Page 5 Treasr Rprt LW Agencies
8.
METRO TOD PLANNING GRANT PROGRAM ROUND 3 APPROVAL AND AUTHORIZATION TO EXECUTE.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to submit the final grant application documents and execute any necessary contract(s) with the Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Agency to receive the Round 3 TOD planning grant.
D-8 Metro Tod Planning Grant Program
D-8 Attachment 03 Round TOD Planning Grant Application
D-8 Attachment 03 Round TOD Planning Grant Application
D-8 Attachment 03 Round TOD Planning Grant Application
E.
CLOSED SESSION
NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC FOR CLOSED SESSION
Prior to going into closed session the City Council will convene in the Auditorium serving as council chambers to take public comment on the closed session items only. General public comment will be provided for during the regular portion of the meeting beginning at 7:30 P.M.
1.
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION - Gov. Code Sec. 54956.9(d)(1). Case Name: Estella Medina vs. City of Azusa (Case No. KC063474).
2.
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION - Gov. Code Sec. 54956.9(d)(1). George Richard Stanford vs. City of Azusa, Workers Compensation Appeals Board numbers ADJ2217325, ADJ970699, ADJ729734
F.
